tasks.title: Introduce yourself — or someone you're with
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Keep it short and natural. Say your name and one thing about yourself, or introduce someone who is happy to take part.

tasks.title: Take a photo of someone you're with
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Ask their permission first. If you're on your own, photograph something interesting nearby instead.

tasks.title: Challenge someone to rock, paper, scissors
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Record one quick round. Best of three if you're feeling competitive. If you're alone, demonstrate the hand signs and explain the rules instead.

tasks.title: Which Evia feature would help a learner most?
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Write a few sentences about the feature you think would be most useful to a learner and why.
